sample_count.question: 1. Number of files / samples
sample_count.caveat: The actual ResPlan.pkl file was loaded.

file_formats.question: 2. File formats
file_formats.caveat: Actual files found in the supplied ResPlan directory.

annotations.question: 3. Available annotations
annotations.caveat: Annotation structure is derived from the actual sampled pickle objects.

room_labels.question: 4. Room labels
room_labels.caveat: Only labels actually present in sampled graph nodes are reported.

geometry_representation.question: 5. Coordinate / geometry representation
geometry_representation.caveat: ResPlan uses vector geometry objects in the sampled data.

adjacency.question: 7. Can adjacency be derived?
adjacency.caveat: Connectivity information is taken from graph edges when available.

room_areas.question: 8. Can room areas be derived?

evidence.note: Geometry areas are reported when the sampled objects expose an area attribute.

room_areas.caveat: Physical units are not guessed by this inspector.

room_aspect_ratios.question: 9. Can room aspect ratios be derived?

evidence.note: Aspect ratios are reported for sampled geometries when bounds are available.

room_aspect_ratios.caveat: Aspect ratios are calculated from vector geometry bounds.

doors_windows.question: 10. Can doors / windows be derived?
doors_windows.caveat: Door/window presence must be confirmed from the actual sampled element keys.

entrances.question: 11. Can entrances be derived?
entrances.caveat: Entrance information is reported only if represented in the sampled data.

stairs.question: 12. Can stairs be derived?
stairs.caveat: Stair information is reported only if represented in the sampled data.

parking_garage.question: 13. Can parking / garage be derived?
parking_garage.caveat: Parking information is reported only if represented in the sampled data.

multi_floor.question: 14. Is multi-floor information present?

evidence.note: The inspector does not assume multi-floor support from the filename. It must be verified from the actual sampled structures.

multi_floor.caveat: Multi-floor support is not inferred without evidence.

reliable_priors.question: 15. Which features are reliable enough to use as priors?
reliable_priors.caveat: These are candidate dataset-derived priors and must be validated before being used by the generator.
